app.name: Prism
app.tagline: The catalog of all your disks

catalog.title: Disks
catalog.subtitle: {online} connected · {total} in the catalog
catalog.empty: No disks yet. Connected disks appear here automatically.
catalog.hashesTitle: {hashed} of {total} files analysed: needed to find duplicates and to check backups

newDisk.title: New disk: {name}
newDisk.question: Do you want to add it to the catalog?
newDisk.manyQuestion: Add them to the catalog? Indexing only reads the disks.

remove.title: Remove “{name}” from the catalog?
remove.body: Prism forgets what it knows about this disk. The files on the disk are not touched.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostartHint: Prism starts in the notification area, without asking for permission.
settings.elevated: Running as administrator: fast indexing (MFT) and live updates are available.
settings.notElevated: Not running as administrator: indexing reads folders one by one.
settings.shortcutHint: Opens the search window from any program.
settings.shortcutError: The shortcut could not be registered ({value}): choose another one.
settings.hashingHint: Prism reads the files of the connected disks in the background, at the lowest priority, to recognise identical files. Network drives are not read.
settings.hashingBattery: Pause it while the PC runs on battery
settings.diagnosticsHint: Prism keeps a log file per day for 14 days. If something goes wrong, the diagnostic package collects the logs and a short system report in a ZIP file you can send.
settings.packageIntro: The package contains these files. The logs include the paths of your files and the names of your disks: look at them before sending the package.
settings.resetHint: Empties the catalog: disks, folders, files and analyses. Useful to start again from scratch.
settings.resetWhat: Every disk leaves the catalog with its folders, files, content analysis and similar images. The connected disks will be proposed again as new disks to index.
settings.resetKeep: No file on your disks is touched. Settings stay.
settings.resetUnderstood: I understand that the catalog of the disconnected disks is lost until they are indexed again

errors.volume_not_found: The disk is no longer in the catalog.
errors.volume_busy: The disk is busy: wait for the current operation to end.
errors.store: The catalog could not be read or written.
errors.autostart_failed: Start with Windows could not be changed.
errors.open_failed: The disk could not be opened in Explorer.
errors.needs_permanent: This disk has no Recycle Bin: confirm the permanent deletion.
errors.delete_failed: The files could not be removed.
errors.shortcut_unavailable: This shortcut is not available: choose another one.
errors.last_copy: This would delete every copy of a file: at least one must stay.
errors.only_offline_copies: Only copies on disconnected disks would remain.
errors.not_hashed: A file changed since it was analysed: refresh the list.
errors.not_found: The item is no longer in the catalog.
errors.backup_overlap: One folder contains the other: choose separate folders.
errors.folder_not_found: That folder is not in the catalog of the disk.
errors.report_expired: This result is no longer available: run the check again.
errors.copy_overlap: The destination is inside the source, or the other way round.
errors.outside_sandbox: Development builds copy only to the test disk PRISMTEST.
errors.not_a_check: Copies start from a backup check.
errors.thumbnail_failed: The preview could not be made.
errors.export_failed: The diagnostic package could not be saved.
errors.not_in_catalog: That folder is not on a disk of the catalog that is connected now.

notify.newDiskBody: Open Prism to index it or to ignore it.
notify.healthTitle: {name}: the disk health is getting worse
notify.healthBody: Open Prism to see the details and copy your files elsewhere.

space.title: Space
space.offline: disk not connected, data from the last indexing ({when})
space.mapLabel: Space map of {name}; the list beside it has the same content
space.name: Name

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.subtitle: Space you can recover on the connected disks. Nothing is removed until you confirm.
cleanup.nothing: Nothing to clean on the connected disks.

why.temp: Files left by installers and programs in the temporary folders of Windows and of your account, older than one day.
why.empty_folders: Folders with no file inside, not even in their subfolders. System and program folders are never proposed.
why.large_old: Files of 500 MB or more that have not changed for a year. They are your files: check each one before removing it.
why.browser_cache: Copies of web pages and images the browser downloads again when needed. Profiles, cookies, passwords and history are never touched.

cleanup.moreLater: and {count} more: clean these, then scan again
cleanup.confirmRecycleTitle: Move the selected items ({count}, {size}) to the Recycle Bin?
cleanup.confirmCheck: Prism checks every item first: anything that changed since the last indexing is left where it is.
cleanup.confirmPermanent: This disk has no Recycle Bin: the files cannot be restored.
cleanup.resultRecycled: Moved to the Recycle Bin: {count}. Freed: {size}.
cleanup.binHint: That space is freed when you empty the Recycle Bin from Explorer.

search.label: Search all disks
search.placeholder: Search all disks… e.g. report size:>1MB ext:pdf
search.help: Type part of a name: every word must appear. Add filters to narrow the search:
search.keys: ↑ ↓ choose · Enter opens · Shift+Enter shows in Explorer · Ctrl+C copies the path · Esc closes the search window.

err.bad_type: “{value}” is not a type (image, video, audio, document, archive, code, program).
err.bad_regex: The regular expression is not valid: {value}

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.subtitle: Identical files on all your disks, connected or not. Nothing is removed until you confirm.
duplicates.nothing: No identical files found with these filters.
duplicates.pending: Content analysis still has {count} files to read: more duplicates may appear.
duplicates.pendingPaused: Content analysis is paused with {count} files still to read.
duplicates.rulesHint: The rules choose, in order, the copy to keep; the others are selected. You can change every check afterwards.

rule.keepOnVolume: Keep the copy on a disk
rule.keepShortestPath: Keep the copy with the shortest path

duplicates.offlineHint: The disk is not connected: this copy cannot be selected.
duplicates.onlyOfflineLeft: Only copies on disconnected disks would remain.
duplicates.confirmRecycle: On internal disks the copies go to the Recycle Bin.
duplicates.confirmPermanent: Some copies are on disks without a Recycle Bin: they will be deleted permanently.
duplicates.confirmCheck: Prism reads each file again first: a file whose content changed is left where it is.
duplicates.confirmOfflineTitle: Keep only copies on disconnected disks?
duplicates.confirmOffline: For some files the only copies left would be on disks that are not connected now. Make sure those disks still work before going on.

backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Check that your files have a copy and compare disks or folders, also disconnected ones.
backup.needTwo: Index at least two disks to check backups or compare them.
backup.byContent: With a copy verified by content: {files} ({percent}%)
backup.byMetadata: With a copy found by name, size and date: {files} ({percent}%)
backup.metadataHint: Files whose content has not been analysed yet are matched by name, size and date.
backup.copyHint: The folders of the source are recreated below this folder. Existing files are never overwritten, and every copy is read back and checked.
backup.conflict: When a different file with the same name is already there
backup.conflictRename: Copy with another name, e.g. photo (2).jpg
backup.notEnough: There is not enough free space on the destination.
backup.copySkipped: Skipped because of a name conflict: {count}.
backup.copyInterrupted: The copy was cancelled. Resuming recognises the files already copied.
backup.modeContent: by content (finds moved and renamed files)

similar.title: Similar
similar.subtitle: Photos, pictures and videos that look the same even if resized, re-encoded or slightly retouched, on all your disks.
similar.nothing: No similar images with this setting.
similar.pending: The content analysis still has {count} images to read: more groups may appear.
similar.pendingVideos: The content analysis still has {count} videos to read: more groups may appear.

identify.title: Which disk is {name}?
identify.question: It looks like more than one disk of the catalog (for example a cloned disk). Which one is it?

unavailable.usb: Disks connected by USB usually do not pass their health data to Windows.
unavailable.virtual: This is a virtual disk: it has no health data of its own.
unavailable.no_access: Prism needs administrator rights to read the health data of this disk.
unavailable.not_supported: This disk does not report health data to Windows.

reason.nvme_critical_warning: The disk reports a critical condition: copy your files elsewhere.
reason.worn_out: The disk has used up its rated life.
reason.wear_high: The disk is near the end of its rated life.
reason.media_errors: The disk has met errors reading or writing data.
reason.smart_failing: The disk reports that it may fail soon: copy your files elsewhere.
reason.attribute_failed: A health value of the disk is below the manufacturer's limit.
reason.reallocated: Some damaged sectors have been replaced with spare ones.
reason.pending: Some sectors are unreadable and waiting to be replaced.
